about: Residue rules read from the checked-out source; mutants.md holds the run-artifact mutant, which is not a text edit.

mutants.name: embed-duplicate-ledger-anchor
mutants.rule: Every ledger edit applies exactly once at HEAD, including literal template edits.

mutants.name: g16fix2-store-platform-dropped
mutants.rule: The closure sweep's std store builds for gobind.Platforms: its copy storePlatforms equals gobind's list, as sets. The edited file is a test file of another package, which this suite's coverage does not instrument.

mutants.name: g16fix2-gobind-platform-dropped
mutants.rule: A platform dropped from gobind.Platforms is dropped from the closure's storePlatforms too.
